ggsql
Grammar of Graphics in SQL
• Alpha-release available
• Works with Quarto, Jupyter, VS Code
• Combines SQL + visualization
• Declarative syntax
• Safe, lightweight runtime
>]sql[label=<
SQL Syntax
• Declarative data manipulation
• Familiar to SQL users
• Powerful data wrangling
• Composable operations
>]grammar_graphics[label=<
Grammar of Graphics
• Modular visualization
• Layer-based composition
• Rich aesthetic mapping
• Inspired by ggplot2
>]features[label=<
Key Features
• VISUALIZE clause for mappings
• DRAW/PLACE for layers
• SCALE for aesthetics
• LABEL for text elements
• Progressive plot evolution
>]workflow[label=<
Example Workflow
1. Data preparation (SQL)
2. Visual mapping (VISUALIZE)
3. Add layers (DRAW)
4. Customize (SCALE/LABEL)
5. Generate visualization
>]benefits[label=<
Benefits
• SQL-native visualization
• No R/Python dependency
• LLM-friendly syntax
• Efficient data processing
• Reproducible reports
>]future[label=<
Future Roadmap
• Rust-based implementation
• Theming system
• Interactive features
• Spatial data support
• Language server
